items.summary: Now the vice-president’s luck is turning, he seems reluctant to commit himself to the next presidential race – and I, for one, hate to see it How do you think history will remember JD Vance? As the first vice-president to spark a vigorous debate about their eyeliner routine ? As one of the last public figures to see Pope Francis alive ? As the only politician in US history to have been the subject of a rumour about sexual relations with a couch (even though it was unfounded)? I have no idea. But it seems increasingly unlikely he will be remembered as the 48th president of the US. After Maga’s midterm thrashing, Vance’s political future doesn’t look as bright as it used to.
